//: #1139 — Every module alias in this project is declared once, in `react/demo/aliases.ts`, and consumed by `react/demo/vite.config.ts` (and by `react/.storybook/main.ts`). TypeScript cannot execute code in a JSON file, so the mirrored `compilerOptions.paths` block lives in the sibling `tsconfig.demo.json` and is inherited from here. Keeping the two blocks in lockstep is what stops the editor/`tsc` and the bundler from disagreeing about which file `@bc-forge/react` or `@bc-forge/ui` actually points at.
